Sentral Expands Residential-Hospitality Portfolio with Fort Lauderdale Debut and Major San Diego Addition

31 Oct 2026, 07:31 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Business Desk · Source: www.prnewswire.com

2 min read

National Expansion and Market Growth

Sentral, a full-building residential-hospitality operator, has announced the addition of two properties to its national portfolio: Diega in downtown San Diego and Veneto Las Olas in Fort Lauderdale. The expansion marks the company's official entry into the Fort Lauderdale market and brings its total operational footprint to 22 markets nationwide. According to the company, the 617-residence Diega property also represents its largest single asset addition of the year.

The announcement coincides with the deployment of Sentral's refreshed corporate brand and redesigned website, aimed at unifying owners, residents, guests, and corporate partners into a single digital hub.

Property Profiles: Diega and Veneto Las Olas

Both properties occupy prominent positions in their respective urban centers:

  • Diega (San Diego): Developed by Bosa Development and located at 702 Broadway where downtown's Core, East Village, and Gaslamp Quarter converge, this 617-residence community spans a full city block. Its dual colored-glass towers were recognized in the San Diego Architectural Foundation's 2025 Orchids and Onions program, receiving an Orchid for interior design. Notable design elements include an interactive mechatronic art installation by BASILE Studio in the South Tower lobby, alongside amenities such as a Sky Terrace pool, coworking areas, lounges, and a pet retreat.
  • Veneto Las Olas (Fort Lauderdale): Developed by the Related Group at 201 South Federal Highway, this 44-floor high-rise offers 259 residences situated one block north of Las Olas Boulevard. Units feature 9- to 12-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling European cabinetry, and private terraces with views of the Atlantic Ocean and the New River. Building amenities include a ninth-floor pool deck and wellness center, plus a resident fitness center, lounge, and theater spanning floors 25 and 26.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

The additions highlight ongoing management trends toward flexible residential-hospitality hybrid models for institutional-grade multi-family assets. Backed by investors including ICONIQ Capital, Highgate Hotels, DivCore Capital, and Ascendant Capital Partners, Sentral manages over $7 billion in real estate assets nationwide.

What is Confirmed vs. Unknown

  • Confirmed: Sentral has taken over operations at Diega in San Diego and Veneto Las Olas in Fort Lauderdale, bringing its portfolio total to 22 markets. Property details, architectural features, and development credits are documented in the official announcement.
  • Unknown: Specific financial terms of the property partnerships, lease rate structures, occupancy rates, and future expansion timelines in either market were not disclosed in the corporate release.

How to Verify the Announcement

Readers can review the primary corporate press release via PR Newswire. Information regarding property leasing and availability can be verified directly through the official property websites at DiegaSanDiego.com and VenetoLasOlas.com, or through Sentral's corporate portal at sentral.com.
